conversation.Statement: Hello, this is Michael from Amazon Security Services. I'm calling about some unusual activity on your Amazon account. Is this Ms. Lawson?
Yes, this is Sarah Lawson. Sorry, can we make this quick? I'm in the middle of something.
Of course, I'll keep this brief. We noticed a purchase attempt for a $1,200 iPhone from your Amazon account this morning. Did you authorize that order?
No, I definitely didn't. I haven't ordered anything like that.

Thank you for confirming, Ms. Lawson. It looks like your account may have been compromised. I want to help secure it right now, so you don't lose any funds. Are you able to verify your email address and the last four digits of your phone number for me?
Yeah, my email is sarahlawson@gmail.com and my phone ends with 2213.
Thanks for that. For your safety, I've frozen your Amazon account temporarily. I also see some attempted changes to your billing info. Can you confirm the bank you usually use for Amazon purchases?
It's First Community Bank. Why do you need that?

We just need to cross-check that no unauthorized accounts were linked. I assure you, everything is confidential. I want to make sure your funds are secure. Do you see any unfamiliar charges on your banking app right now?
I haven't checked, to be honest. I've been too busy. Should I look?
If you could check quickly, that would be helpful. Meanwhile, I'll stay on the line and guide you through the next steps. Please let me know if you see anything out of the ordinary.
Okay, just give me a second... No, nothing weird shows up so far.

That's good news. However, as a precaution, Amazon recommends that customers move their available funds to a government-safe account while we finish the investigation. This is to stop potential hackers from accessing your money.
What does that mean? Move my money where, exactly?
We use a secure, federally-insured holding account. I'll provide the details. It's a temporary step to protect you. Once the investigation is cleared, your funds will be sent right back to you.
This sounds complicated. I really don't have a lot of time right now.
I completely understand, and I'll help you finish this in just a few minutes. If you can log in to your online banking app, I'll walk you through the transfer steps.
Okay, I'm logged in. What do I need to do?
Thank you, Ms. Lawson. Please select the 'Transfer Funds' option, and I'll give you the safe account number and routing code for the transfer.
Alright, I see the transfer screen. What's the account number?
Please enter account number 321501872 and routing number 021000021. The recipient's name is 'Amazon Security Holdings.'
How much am I supposed to send?
To fully secure your funds, transfer your current available balance. This ensures nothing is left vulnerable in your main account.
Are you sure this is safe? I'm just worried about sending my money.
I understand your concern, Ms. Lawson. You have my assurance that this is a standard Amazon security procedure. Your funds are protected and fully traceable, and only you can authorize their return.
Okay, I'll enter the details now.
Thank you. Once the transfer is complete, please let me know. I'll verify on our end and issue a confirmation number for your records.
It's processing. Will I need to do anything else?
Once you see the confirmation, please send me a screenshot or the transaction reference number. That will help us track your secure funds and speed up your account restoration.
Alright, it says completed. The reference is 897654.
Perfect, Ms. Lawson. For extra security, could you confirm your full address on file? I'll update our records and email you the official case closure notice.
It's 211 Maple Ridge, Auburn, NY 13021.
Thank you for your cooperation. You should see an email from Amazon Security within the next 30 minutes. If you have any questions, I'll be happy to help further.
Alright, I hope this is really going to keep my money safe. I have to get back to my mom now.
You've done the right thing, Ms. Lawson. Your funds are protected and your account is now secure. If you receive any suspicious emails or calls, please report them directly to us. Have a good day.
